items.title: HDFC Bank Q4 preview: PAT seen stable with up to 10% YoY growth; NIM pressure persists. 8 things to watch
items.description: HDFC Bank is expected to post a steady Q4FY26, with PAT likely growing 6–10% YoY and NIM pressure persisting. Brokerages foresee moderate NII growth, stable asset quality, and healthy deposits. Key monitorables include NIM trajectory, credit costs, loan–deposit gap, and management commentary after the Chairman’s exit.

items.title: ICICI Bank Q4 preview: PAT to grow up to 6% YoY, NII seen rising up to 8%. 8 things to watch
items.description: ICICI Bank is expected to post a steady Q4FY26 performance, with brokerages projecting 2–6% YoY PAT growth and a 4–8% rise in NII. While loan growth and asset quality remain healthy, margins may face mild pressure. Key monitorables include NIM trajectory, deposit trends, credit costs, and provisioning.

items.title: Jio Financial Q4 Results: Cons PAT declines 14% YoY to Rs 272 crore despite 106% surge in revenue
items.description: Jio Financial Q4 Results: Jio Financial Services on Friday reported a 14% year-on-year decline in its consolidated net profit for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 at Rs 272 crore compared to Rs 316 crore in the year ago period even as revenue surged 106% to Rs 1,019 crore.

items.title: RIL to announce Q4 earnings on April 24; board to consider final dividend
items.description: Reliance Industries will announce Q4FY26 earnings on April 24 as its board meets to approve results and consider final dividend for FY26 followed by an analyst meet to discuss performance and outlook
